run_update_pep503_index: run the script to update PEP 503 package index pages on an S3 bucket
create_or_update_project_index: create or update the project-level index page with links to all project names
create_or_update_package_index: create or update a package index page listing all wheel files for a project
upload_index: upload an HTML index file to an S3 bucket with cache control metadata
get_s3_bucket: get an S3 bucket resource using boto3 with an optional AWS profile name
